sentences.text:
Present: Mr. Munfaid Khan,
Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Praveen Bhadu, Aag, Haryana.
Mahabir Singh Sindhu.

J. 
Present petition has been filed under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for seeking bail pending trial in FIR No.30 dated 15.02.2022 registered under Section 379-A IPC, at Police Station, Bhupani, District Faridabad.
2. Allegations in brief are that on 14.02.2022, victim who was a pedestrian, was attacked by a youth from behind, who grabbed his neck and snatched away his mobile phone and cash of Rs.700/-.
3. Learned counsel contends that petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Also contends that out of 08 prosecution witnesses, only 03 have been examined till date; thus,
conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
4.
Per contra, learned State counsel while opposing the prayer submits that petitioner had actively participated in the commission of crime.
He has produced custody certificate dated 10.04.2024 and the same is taken on record.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the paper-book.

A perusal of aforesaid custody certificate reveals that apart from the present case, petitioner is involved in 08 other cases, which are detailed as under:-
Sr. FIR Dated Under Police Status of No. No. Sections Station trial 1. 64 13.02.2022 379-A/34 Sector 31, Pending IPC Faridabad 2. 367 09.08.2015 394 IPC Sector 55, Pending Faridabad 3. 314 31.03.2024 25 Arms Palla, Pending Act District Faridabad 4. 376 22.10.2020 379 IPC SGM Convicted Nagar, Faridabad 5. 628 06.10.2020 379 IPC Palla, Convicted Faridabad 6. 157 11.03.2021 379 IPC Mujjessar Convicted Faridabad 7. 303 01.05.2016 380 IPC Sector 31, Convicted Faridabad 8
379-A IPC GRP, Convicted Faridabad 7.
Thus, petitioner is a habitual offender and his antecedents are not clean.
8. In view of the above, this Court is not inclined to grant bail pending trial to the petitioner, at this stage.
9. Consequently, there is no option, except to dismiss the petition.

10. Ordered accordingly.
11.
Needless to say that interim order dated 07.02.2024 granting interim bail to the petitioner, shall come to an end, automatically.
